entries.title: Numbers 28:1
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 28:2
segments: Command the sons of Israel, and say to them, My offering [and] My bread for My sacrifices made by fire, a sweet savor to Me, you shall be careful to offer to Me in their due season.

entries.title: Numbers 28:3
segments: And you shall say to them, This [is] the fire offering which you shall offer to the LORD: two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, a continual burnt offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:4
segments: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning, and the other lamb you shall offer between the evenings.

entries.title: Numbers 28:5
segments: And a tenth of an ephah of flour for a food offering, mixed with the fourth of a hin of beaten oil.

entries.title: Numbers 28:6
segments: [It is] a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD,

entries.title: Numbers 28:7
segments: and its drink offering [shall be] the fourth of a hin for the one lamb. Pour a drink offering [of] strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

entries.title: Numbers 28:8
segments: And the other lamb you shall offer between the evenings, even as the food offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer [it], a fire offering, a sweet savor to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:9
segments: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two-tenth parts of flour [for] a food offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering;

entries.title: Numbers 28:10
segments: [this is] the burnt offering of every sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:11
segments: And in the beginning of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot,

entries.title: Numbers 28:12
segments: and three tenth parts of flour [for] a food offering, mixed with oil, for one bull, and two-tenth parts of flour [for] a food offering, mixed with oil, for one ram;

entries.title: Numbers 28:13
segments: and a separate tenth part of flour mixed with oil [for] a food offering to one lamb, for a burnt offering of a sweet savor, a fire offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:14
segments: And their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine to a bull, and the third of a hin to a ram, and a fourth a hin to a lamb. This [is] the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

entries.title: Numbers 28:15
segments: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering to the LORD shall be prepared, besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:16
segments: And in the fourteenth day of the first month [is] the Passover of the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 28:17
segments: And in the fifteenth day of this month [is] the feast. Seven days shall unleavened [bread] be eaten.

entries.title: Numbers 28:18
segments: In the first day [shall be] a holy convocation. You shall do no kind of laboring work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:19
segments: But you shall offer a fire offering [for] a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year. They shall be to you without blemish.

entries.title: Numbers 28:20
segments: And their food offering [shall be] of flour mixed with oil: three tenth parts you shall prepare for a bull, and two tenth parts for a ram.

entries.title: Numbers 28:21
segments: You shall prepare one tenth part for the one lamb, and for the seven lambs;

entries.title: Numbers 28:22
segments: and one goat, a sin offering to make an atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:23
segments: You shall prepare these besides the burnt offering in the morning, which [is] for a continual burnt offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:24
segments: In this way you shall offer daily, seven days, the bread of the fire offering, a sweet savor to the LORD. It shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

entries.title: Numbers 28:25
segments: And on the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:26
segments: And in the day of the first-fruits, when you bring a new food offering to the LORD in your Feast of Weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no laboring work.

entries.title: Numbers 28:27
segments: And you shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savor to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven lambs of the first year

entries.title: Numbers 28:28
segments: and their food offering of flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts to one bull, two tenth parts to one ram,

entries.title: Numbers 28:29
segments: one tenth part to one lamb, for the seven lambs,

entries.title: Numbers 28:30
segments: one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

entries.title: Numbers 28:31
segments: You shall offer [them] besides the continual burnt offering and its food offering and their drink offerings. They shall be to you without blemish.
